what_to_detect: A creature with lethal damage marked (or dealt lethal damage by the resolution) that stays on the battlefield because it is indestructible.
near_miss: A creature with lethal damage marked that is not indestructible and dies in the state-based check.
record_fields: absence of an unresolved zone_change to the graveyard

what_to_detect: A creature with indestructible printed on it that survives lethal damage or a destroy effect (it stays on the battlefield).
near_miss: A creature without indestructible hit by the same lethal damage or destroy effect, which dies.
record_fields: resolution effect half damage_dealt / destroyed events
absence of a zone_change to the graveyard
